name: wanted
description: The wanted stars of the HUD. The higher the value, the more stars light up, and a full wanted level flashes.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric that lights up the stars, e.g. the CPU temperature

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The value with no star lit. Defaults to 0

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The value with all stars lit. If not set, percentages and °C use 100 and other metrics their highest recorded value

config.name: align
config.label: Alignment
config.description: Where the stars sit in a widget wider than they are

config.name: no_flash
config.label: No Flashing
config.description: Keeps the stars from flashing when all of them are lit

config.name: star_color
config.label: Star Color
config.description: The color of the lit stars. Defaults to white

config.name: empty_color
config.label: Empty Color
config.description: The color of the unlit stars
